captions.detailed: A pair of identical, symmetric spool bearings or axle adapters designed to fit inside a filament spool. Each adapter consists of a stepped cylindrical body, featuring a wider base collar that acts as a spacer and a narrower upper cylinder designed to insert into the spool's inner core. A central cylindrical bore runs completely through the center of each adapter to accommodate a mounting axle.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric pair of symmetric spool axle adapters in OpenSCAD. The script should allow users to customize the spool hole diameter, spool insertion depth, axle diameter, and the height of the outer spacer ring, placing two identical parts side-by-side with a configurable separation distance.
captions.factory: The code generates two identical adapters using a symmetric layout. Each adapter is constructed by unioning two coaxial cylinders: a larger-diameter cylinder for the spacer/end cap, and a smaller-diameter cylinder translated on top to serve as the spool contact point. A single central cylinder representing the axle hole is then subtracted from the union using the difference() operator. The two parts are positioned side-by-side using translate() transforms based on the spool hole diameter and separation parameters.
